Upload a Local File to Databrary

Source: R/upload_file.R
upload_file.Rd

High-level wrapper around the upload pipeline: initiate_upload -> PUT bytes to the signed URL(s) -> complete_upload (multipart only). Returns the metadata needed to poll progress with get_upload_status.

Picks the upload mode the server returned: single PUT on the on-prem core deployment or for small files on AWS, S3 multipart for large files on AWS.

Usage

upload_file(
  path,
  destination_type,
  object_id,
  filename = NULL,
  content_type = NULL,
  source_session_id = NULL,
  source_folder_id = NULL,
  vb = options::opt("vb"),
  rq = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Path to the local file. Must exist and be readable.

destination_type

See initiate_upload.

object_id

See initiate_upload.

filename

Optional display filename; defaults to basename(path).

content_type

Optional MIME type; auto-detected from the file extension when not supplied.

source_session_id

See initiate_upload.

source_folder_id

See initiate_upload.

vb

Show verbose messages. (Defaults to FALSE, overwritable using option 'databraryr.vb' or environment variable 'R_DATABRARYR_VB')

rq

An httr2 request object. Defaults to NULL.

Value

A named list with upload_guid (when known), status_url, and upload_type. Returns NULL if any step fails.

See also

initiate_upload, get_upload_status, complete_upload

Examples

# \donttest{
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
info <- upload_file(
  path = "/tmp/clip.mp4",
  destination_type = "session",
  object_id = 42
)
get_upload_status(status_url = info$status_url)
} # }
# }
